result.instructions: Tools for Beebole, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many hours did our team log against the Website project last week?"; "Log 90 minutes on the Design task for me today, starting at 09:00 UTC."; "List the active projects and their ids so I can log time against one.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Beebole data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run beebole_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run beebole_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run beebole_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. beebole_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: beebole_current_person
tools.title: Current person
tools.description: Return the person that the API key belongs to: id, name and email. Call it first to learn the person id that the other tools need. GraphQL: currentPerson.

tools.name: beebole_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List the people in the account with their id, name and archived flag. GraphQL: getPersons.

archived.description: true lists archived people, false lists active people. Leave out for both.

tools.name: beebole_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects with their id and name. Filter by project category id or archived flag. Use the ids in beebole_log_time. GraphQL: getProjects.

category_id.description: Only projects in this project category (from the Beebole project category).

archived.description: true lists archived projects, false lists active ones.

tools.name: beebole_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks with their id, name, start and end times, and status. Filter by planning (task category) id or archived flag. Use the ids in beebole_log_time. GraphQL: getTasks.

category_id.description: Only tasks in this planning (task category).

archived.description: true lists archived tasks, false lists active ones.

tools.name: beebole_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List tags (groups of people, projects and tasks) with their id, name and level. GraphQL: getTags.

category_id.description: Only tags in this tag category.

archived.description: true lists archived tags, false lists active ones.

tools.name: beebole_list_time_records
tools.title: List time records
tools.description: List logged time records (not time off) that start between two dates, inclusive, in UTC. The window can be up to 366 days. Each record has its id, duration in milliseconds, start time, person and projects. GraphQL: getTimeRecords.

person_id.description: Only records of this person (from beebole_current_person or beebole_list_people).

tools.name: beebole_log_time
tools.title: Log time
tools.description: Create one time record for a person: start time (ISO 8601), duration in minutes, and optional task, projects, comment and non-billable flag. Creates data in the account. GraphQL: addTimeRecord.

person_id.description: The person the time belongs to (from beebole_current_person or beebole_list_people).

start_time.description: When the work started, ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-25T09:00:00Z.

task_id.description: The task to log against (from beebole_list_tasks).

non_billable.description: true marks the time as non-billable.

tools.name: beebole_update_time_record_duration
tools.title: Change time record duration
tools.description: Set a new duration, in minutes, on an existing time record. Overwrites the logged duration. GraphQL: editTimeRecordDuration.

time_record_id.description: The time record to change (from beebole_list_time_records).

tools.name: beebole_update_time_record_comment
tools.title: Change time record comment
tools.description: Replace the comment on an existing time record. GraphQL: editTimeRecordComment.

time_record_id.description: The time record to change (from beebole_list_time_records).

comment.description: The new comment. An empty string clears it.
